display.title: Torch Bundle

lines: Good. Darkness is patient, but I do not plan to reward it.
Put Torch Bundle aside for now?

abandoned: I will set the torch rack aside. Return if the village still needs more light.
abandoned_cooldown: I will pause the torch request for now. Let the watch settle before asking again.
abandoned_forever: Then the torch request is closed for good.
unavailable: There is no torch request here for me to close.

lines: Then keep the torches dry until you are ready.
Torch Bundle is still open. I can repeat the details, or close my notes if you are done.

completed: Torch Bundle is complete. The village can use this, and you have earned the reward.
inactive: The watch rack is not accepting torches right now.
missing_objectives: Torch Bundle is still short. The tracker has the exact count.
missing_proof: Torch Bundle still needs the torches in your pack before I can close it.
missing_target: Torch Bundle is not at the right count yet; bring the rest before turning it in.
unavailable: This torch request is not ready to close yet.

lines: Then the shadows may continue acting more confident than they are.
A few corners of the village are getting ideas after dusk.
More torches would remind them who actually lives here.

inactive: The watch has no active torch count at the moment.
reminder: Torch Bundle: I still need the torches. Bring the full count back to me.
unavailable: That torch request is not in your hands right now.

already_completed: The torch rack is already settled.
locate_failed: Torch Bundle cannot be posted from here right now.
started: Torch Bundle is yours now. Bring the torches back when the count is ready.
unavailable: The watch rack is not asking you for torches right now.

lines: If you have the torches, we can settle Torch Bundle.
Keep the torches close until the watch rack can take them.
